fields: as a table: cols [your request, first response, what follows] (the two value labels head the lane zones), rows [request, first response, what follows], intro, nav. Cells may be {t, link, intent}.
best_for: ResponseLanes draws a table of response times by request as lanes on one clock: each request runs from where you call or send through its first response into what follows, every clause a stop with its time beneath, and the severities set as a calm scale of huge light numerals.

block.intro: Times apply on a service plan; without one, a call-out with the next available technician.
